Cancellation Policy

Confirmed Accommodation can be cancelled through email only.

  • Email: hospitality.aakaar@gmail.com
  • Subject: "Cancellation of Accommodation"
  • Deadline: 6th March 2027 (for 75% refund)
  • No refund provided after the deadline. Refunds processed within 25 working days post-fest.

Strict Guidelines

  • ID Mandatory: College ID + Govt ID (Aadhaar) required at all times.
  • Separation: Boys and girls will be strictly provided separate accommodation.
  • Prohibited: Alcohol, drugs, sharp objects, and explosives are strictly banned.
  • Punctuality: Check-out timings are absolute.

Frequently Asked Questions

Fill the registration form above, complete the payment, and wait for confirmation email. Report to the venue mentioned in the mail upon arrival.

Closest stations: Kanjurmarg (Central Line) or Andheri (Western Line). From there, take an auto/bus to IIT Main Gate, Powai.
